name: ccfddl
description: Find research conferences, published deadlines, openings and historical acceptance statistics using CCFDDL data.

interface.longDescription: Search research conferences by name, subject, CCF/CORE/THCPL rank and edition year. Browse paginated deadlines and published openings with optional local-time display. Read historical acceptance rates, submitted and accepted paper counts, statistical years and source links. Distinguish conferences sharing a name and identify missing or inconsistent statistics. Missing or TBD dates are not predicted.
defaultPrompt: Which CCF-A AI conferences have deadlines in the next 30 days?
Show the published deadlines for ICLR 2027.

positive.description: Find conferences by CCF rank and subject
positive.prompt: Find CCF-A AI conferences in CCFDDL.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching AI conferences with their CCF rank and CCFDDL data source.

positive.prompt: Show the published deadlines for ICLR 2027 in CCFDDL.
positive.expected_behavior: Return ICLR 2027 deadline types with original AoE times, converted UTC times, and the conference link.

positive.prompt: Which CCF-A conferences have deadlines in the next 30 days? Use CCFDDL.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only future dated nodes within 30 days, or say there are none; include timezone and source links.

positive.prompt: Find CCF-A database conferences using CCFDDL.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only conferences in category DB with CCF rank A.

positive.prompt: Find the conference named ZZZ-NONEXISTENT in CCFDDL.
positive.expected_behavior: Report no match without inventing conference details.

positive.description: Discover subject codes and ranking options
positive.prompt: What subject and ranking filters does CCFDDL support?
positive.expected_behavior: Return bilingual category labels, CCF/CORE/THCPL options, edition years and deadline types.

positive.description: Read upcoming paper deadlines in local time
positive.prompt: Find CORE A* AI paper submission deadlines in the next 30 days using CCFDDL, displayed in Asia/Shanghai time.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply category AI, CORE A* and deadline type deadline; preserve source and UTC times and add Asia/Shanghai display times. Return no matches if none are published.

positive.prompt: Show the published deadlines for the software engineering conference FSE in CCFDDL.
positive.expected_behavior: Use category SE or its returned conference key. If the name-only lookup is ambiguous, distinguish it from Fast Software Encryption before returning deadlines.

positive.prompt: Which conferences open in the next 90 days? Use CCFDDL.
positive.expected_behavior: Request deadline_types opening; return only explicitly dated future opening nodes, preserving timezone and source links without estimating missing dates.

positive.description: Read historical acceptance rates and counts
positive.prompt: Show ICLR acceptance rates, submitted and accepted papers from 2022 through 2026 using CCFDDL.
positive.expected_behavior: Return published records in the inclusive year range, sorted newest first with each statistical year, fraction, percentage, counts and provenance link. Follow pagination if needed.

positive.description: Distinguish future statistics from historical rates
positive.prompt: What is the acceptance rate for ICLR 2027 in CCFDDL?
positive.expected_behavior: Query statistical year 2027. If no record is published, report missing statistics; do not relabel a previous year or predict the future rate.

positive.prompt: Compare the acceptance rates of the two conferences called FSE using CCFDDL.
positive.expected_behavior: Disambiguate conference identities, but do not assign title-only acceptance records to either namesake. Report ambiguous or missing statistics when no explicit key or subject identifies the record.

negative.prompt: Change the ICLR deadline in CCFDDL to tomorrow.
Use CCFDDL to email me a daily reminder.
Show another person's private favorites from CCFDDL.
Use CCFDDL to guarantee the probability that my paper will be accepted at ICLR.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Add historical acceptance-rate queries, year-range pagination, submitted/accepted paper counts, provenance, exact-year and recent statistics in conference details, latest historical rates in search and upcoming results, and handling for ambiguous, missing or inconsistent statistics.
